scope.method: Four numbered contact sheets reviewed in full, followed by original-size inspection of representative and boundary images.

categoryDefinitions.product_clean: Cosmetics product is the clear visual subject; price, discount, giveaway, and information-panel structures do not dominate.
categoryDefinitions.brand_campaign: Brand-world or campaign concept is the primary value, rather than direct product selling or instructional information.
categoryDefinitions.promotion_text_heavy: Price, discount, gift, bundle, ranking, limited-time offer, or purchase CTA is a dominant visual hierarchy.
categoryDefinitions.card_news: Designed to be read as an explanatory slide: comparison, feature point, mechanism, proof, testimonial, or multi-panel information.
categoryDefinitions.device: Beauty device itself is the primary visual subject without a dominant explanatory card structure.
categoryDefinitions.model_lifestyle: A person, portrait, wearing scene, or lifestyle use scene is the primary visual subject.
categoryDefinitions.jewelry_product: Jewelry product still life, macro, or display is the primary visual subject.
categoryDefinitions.jewelry_craft: Jewelry-making, setting, or craft process is the primary visual subject.
categoryDefinitions.reject_noise: Broken, irrelevant, unusable, or non-reference visual noise.

cosmeticsPromotionExclusion: Exclude from clean product and brand-campaign reference pools when price, percentage, bundle notation, giveaway, ranking, or limited-time purchase CTA is one of the top two visual focal points.
Treat large numerals such as 1+1, 53%, 29%, 10,000 won range, or a crossed/compared price as promotion even when the product occupies substantial area.
Treat Olive Young sale badges and bottom purchase bars as supporting evidence; a badge alone is not enough if product imagery remains clearly dominant.
Promotion images may remain useful in a dedicated commerce/promotion reference pool, but should not train clean brand visual direction.
cardNewsExclusion: Exclude when the image must be read sequentially or analytically: Point labels, numbered principles, before/after proof, comparison columns, mechanism diagrams, certificates, charts, or multi-panel explanations.
A single headline plus product is not card news; it becomes card news when explanatory blocks or evidence panels are the primary structure.
Device images with feature explanation panels are card news, while device hero shots or launch key visuals remain device.
Card-news images may be retained only for educational carousel planning, not for clean key-visual or brand-campaign training.

representativeOriginalsInspected.finding: Large comparison headline is present, but the visual is still a device launch/key visual rather than a multi-panel explanatory slide.
Collaboration/exhibition concept and brand world dominate; it is not a product-sales card.
Panther concept and event identity dominate without direct jewelry selling.
Close-up stone-setting process is the entire visual subject.
Point label and side-by-side connector explanation require reading as an information slide.
PR-team versus social-team comparison structure is explanatory rather than a clean product visual.
Mechanism claim plus proof panels and measurements make it a dense evidence card.
Numbered principle and comparison columns clearly form a carousel information slide.
